newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates consolidated in a narrow range in dull trading in the absence of market-moving news.

Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the People's Bank of China, the central bank, from coastal areas including Hainan, Shenzhen and Jiangsu were major net borrowers today while state banks were net lenders.
The market is likely to continue to move narrowly in the short term but is under downward pressure in the mid-term due to an expected bank reserve ratio cut before the end of this year, traders said.
